descricao_original: Proteins for export are synthesized by the RER and transferred to the Golgi via transport vesicles. The Golgi modifies these proteins and packages them as secretory granules for transport to the plasma membrane, where they are released from the cells by exocytosis. Secretory granules consist of a single membrane surrounding the contents of the the granule.
